skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo of 50% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo of 70% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire column. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on back-row targets for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. rate by 35%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo of 70% ATK DMG to each enemy in the entire column. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on all targets in the column for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. rate by 35%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP%. When Spring Mustachio is attacked, if the attacker is in the [Shatter] state, the DMG is reduced by 40%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP%. When Spring Mustachio is attacked, if the attacker is in the [Shatter] state, the DMG is reduced by 50%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP%. When Spring Mustachio is attacked, if the attacker is in the [Shatter] state, the DMG is reduced by 60%.
